note: Larue County and Hodgenville (joint zoning ordinance) publish zoning district maps only as a static PDF (PZ-Maps.pdf) and ordinance text. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub, the county site, the Lincoln Trail ADD map library and the City of Hodgenville found no queryable zoning district polygon service. Only third-party copies (Zoneomics, Rezone) and paid parcel data exist.
